name: campus-city-quest
description: Location-based onboarding game for incoming international students at DHBW Heilbronn

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run watch --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.screenshots: cross-env SCREENSHOTS=1 npm run e2e --prefix frontend
scripts.lint:py: python -m black --check --config tests/pyproject.toml tests/conftest.py tests/python tests/regression && python -m pylint --rcfile tests/.pylintrc tests/conftest.py tests/python tests/regression
scripts.format:py: python -m black --config tests/pyproject.toml tests/conftest.py tests/python tests/regression
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run lint:py && npm run test:all
